three ways to define style and performance. the 2012 Kia Forte comes in three

Advanced technology for stirring performance. the Forte offers two
exciting ways to enjoy your time driving. Lx and ex models have a 156-hp
engine,2 and Sx models deliver even more performance with a 173-hp
2.4L power plant.2 Both engines feature Continuously variable valve
timing (Cvvt) that automatically adjusts valve timing to provide increased
power, reduced exhaust emissions and optimum fuel efficiency.3
2, 3 See Specifications page for endnotes. FoRte KoUP Sx Shown.

Prepare for the unexpected. Forte’s safety systems are designed to help minimize
injury when a traffic accident is unavoidable. the front seats feature active
headrests and seat-belt pretensioners. Dual front airbags, front-seat-mounted
side airbags and side curtain airbags for both front and rear seating positions
are managed by an advanced sensor system.9 Forte wraps all of this — and you
— in a protective, high-strength steel-reinforced body.
